facts.text: I was trying to get a better handle on my online presence and messaging habits.
I had a conversation with a friend on Facebook Messenger last month that lasted about an hour.
I sent 43 messages during that Facebook Messenger conversation.
I was chatting with my friend about life in general.
My conversation with my friend was casual and not too specific.
I think I was driving the conversation forward with my own topics and questions.
My online communication style is similar to my in-person style.
I try to be genuine and friendly in both online and in-person settings.
In-person, I discuss more personal stuff like relationships or serious life decisions.
Online, I stick to more casual stuff like hobbies or pop culture.
I am part of a WhatsApp group chat with my college friends.
I have sent around 150 messages in that WhatsApp group chat since we started chatting on June 20th.
Conflicts in the WhatsApp group chat are pretty rare.
When conflicts come up in the WhatsApp group chat, we usually just laugh it off and move on.
We are laid-back and don't want disagreements to ruin the vibe of the chat.
In the WhatsApp group chat, we mostly stick to lighthearted stuff.
In the WhatsApp group chat, we sometimes discuss current events or pop culture news.
In the WhatsApp group chat, we have discussed new movies or TV shows.
I have had great conversations on Twitter.
I have been pretty active on Twitter lately, tweeting about 10 times a week.
I engage with others' tweets on Twitter.
I gained a few new followers after liking and retweeting a post from a popular comedian on July 3rd.
